verdicts.reason: A cuts the sea photo down to a sliver at the left edge. Its tiny, low-contrast Meridian logo sits between the copy and the Book Now button, which breaks the reading order. B keeps a real image panel and puts the logo first in the reading order, though the logo is small and sits on the photo with weak contrast. In both, the subhead is close to illegible at 320x50 and the copy block is cramped against the button.
